name: atheleos-admin
description: Atheleos Admin Panel — administration and moderation console for the Atheleos platform (Flutter + Firebase app).

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @atheleos/api & npm run dev -w @atheleos/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atheleos/shared && npm run build -w @atheleos/api && npm run build -w @atheleos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @atheleos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @atheleos/api && npm run typecheck -w @atheleos/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @atheleos/api && npm run test -w @atheleos/web
